disclaimer: Parts are aftermarket-to-quality retail bands for a common passenger car. Hours are typical book times — not a licensed Motor or Mitchell guide. Luxury, trucks, and seized hardware run longer. This is Open Hood’s independent typical-hour book.

jobs.label: Oil + filter
jobs.scope: Full synthetic LOF, one filter, passenger car
jobs.notes: Ask for the viscosity and the liters on the RO. A $15 shop-supply line on a $70 LOF is padding. Cabin filter is a separate yes.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Write the oil spec and the filter brand on the ticket. If you are above {high} for a synthetic LOF in this ZIP, I want the door rate and I will decline the cabin-filter add-on.
ask: Write the oil spec and the liters on the RO.
What is the posted door rate if this LOF is above the independent band?
Is every add-on a separate yes — cabin, flush, induction?

jobs.label: Brake pads (axle)
jobs.scope: Pad R&R, one axle, hardware included in parts
jobs.notes: Pads only if the rotors measure above discard. Ask for millimeters, not “they’re due.” Electronic parking brake on a rear axle is extra time — make them write it.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Please measure both rotors in millimeters and write the discard spec. Pad-only at {high} is the top of the independent band for this ZIP. If you need rotors, that is a second line with its own hours.
ask: Measure both rotors in millimeters and write the discard spec.
Are shop supplies a flat hazmat line or a percent of the RO?
Pads and rotors stay two lines if both are due.

jobs.label: Rotors (axle)
jobs.scope: Rotor R&R, one axle — pads are a separate parts line
jobs.notes: Thickness versus discard. If they quoted pads + rotors as one lump, do not pay two full labor books. Resurface only if the hat is true and the shop still does it.
jobs.sayIfHigh: I need the rotor thickness in millimeters next to the discard spec. A rotor job above {high} in this ZIP needs hours and the posted door rate on the RO before I authorize.

jobs.label: 12-volt battery
jobs.scope: Flooded or AGM 12V, plus registration when the car needs it
jobs.notes: Ask for CCA and flooded vs AGM. Many late models need a battery registration — that is time, not a $200 programming mystery. The 12-volt still bricks an EV.
jobs.sayIfHigh: What is the CCA, and does this car need a registration? A 12-volt above {high} in this ZIP needs the brand and the test printout on the ticket.

jobs.label: Spark plugs (set)
jobs.scope: Full set, common 4-cyl to V6. Coils are a separate line
jobs.notes: Iridium is not a $90 plug. Tube seals and coil boots are separate wear. A transverse V6 with the intake off is the high-hours end — make them write why.
jobs.sayIfHigh: How many hours, and is the intake coming off? Plug-only above {high} in this ZIP is dealer-adjacent. Coils stay off the ticket until a misfire test says so.

jobs.label: Starter
jobs.scope: Starter R&R after a confirmed no-crank test
jobs.notes: Confirm crank amps or a click before the part. Some transverse fours need the intake or the axle out — that is the high-hours end, written on the RO.
jobs.sayIfHigh: What was the crank-amp or voltage-drop reading? A starter above {high} in this ZIP needs the hours and whether anything else comes off to reach it.

jobs.label: Alternator
jobs.scope: Alternator R&R after a charging test
jobs.notes: Charging test at the battery and at the alternator. A decoupler pulley is a wear item, not a reason to replace the whole unit by default. Reman vs new — write the brand.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Show me the charging-test numbers. Alternator above {high} in this ZIP needs hours, the brand, and reman vs new on the line.

jobs.label: Water pump
jobs.scope: Mechanical or electric pump. Timing-belt-driven pumps ride with the belt job
jobs.notes: If the pump is behind the timing belt, this is a belt job — do not pay pump labor and belt labor as two full books. Electric pumps on some late models are a different, shorter book.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Is this pump belt-driven? If yes, quote the belt job as one operation. A standalone pump above {high} in this ZIP needs the hours and the access story on the RO.

jobs.label: Timing belt / water pump kit
jobs.scope: Belt kit with pump and tensioner on a scheduled interval. Chain is a failure — not a menu
jobs.notes: Belt: interval in miles or years on the service schedule — kit often includes pump and tensioner. Chain: not “due.” Authorize a chain job only with a rattle, a correlation test, or a known failure. Chain books often run 8–20 hours and are not this band. Typical hours — not Motor.
jobs.sayIfHigh: If this is a belt, show me the interval page. If this is a chain, I want the noise, the cam/crank correlation, and why it is not a maintenance menu. A number above {high} needs hours on the RO before I sign.

jobs.label: Calipers (axle pair)
jobs.scope: Two calipers, one axle. Slides and hoses are separate yeses
jobs.notes: A seized slide is not automatically two new calipers. Ask which side stuck and whether a pin-and-boot service was offered. Loaded calipers include pads — do not also pay a full pad parts line.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Which side was stuck, and did you offer a slide service? Two new calipers above {high} in this ZIP need the brand and whether they are loaded.

jobs.label: Alignment
jobs.scope: Four-wheel alignment, print before and after
jobs.notes: Menu price, not a parts job. Demand the before/after print. Aftermarket tires and lowered cars need a shop that will still print the numbers. An alignment without a print is a wash.
jobs.sayIfHigh: I want the before-and-after print. Alignment above {high} in this ZIP is dealer-adjacent — write the door rate or I will take the print to a second rack.

jobs.label: Inspection / diagnostic
jobs.scope: Booked diagnostic hour. Not the repair
jobs.notes: Diagnosis is a line. It is not the repair. Ask what test the hour buys and the not-to-exceed before they open it. MPI adjectives are not a diagnostic.
jobs.sayIfHigh: What test does this hour buy, and what is the not-to-exceed? Diagnostic above {high} in this ZIP needs the test name on the RO. The repair is a second authorization.

jobs.label: Cabin air filter
jobs.scope: Pollen / cabin filter R&R, passenger car
jobs.notes: Glove-box DIY on most cars. $80+ parts-and-labor is almost always padding. Not the engine air filter.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Cabin filter at {high} in this ZIP is the top of the independent band. I will R&R it in the lot if you cannot show me why the box is that high.
ask: Why is a glove-box part a labor line?
Write the brand and the list price.

jobs.label: Coolant drain-and-fill
jobs.scope: Drain-and-fill, OEM coolant, passenger car — not a machine flush unless specified
jobs.notes: Color is not a spec. Ask for the OEM coolant name. A pressurized flush is a different authorization — our regex book flags flush language as an upsell.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Write the OEM coolant name on the RO. A drain-and-fill above {high} in this ZIP needs the why — a machine flush is a second yes.
ask: Write the OEM coolant name — color is not a spec.
Was a drain-and-fill offered, or only a machine flush?
What test or interval page requires this today?

jobs.label: Brake fluid exchange
jobs.scope: Bleed and fill, DOT as-capped, passenger car
jobs.notes: DOT lives on the cap. Moisture test or a stated interval — not a bundled “brake service” next to pads.
jobs.sayIfHigh: What DOT, and did you test moisture? Brake fluid above {high} in this ZIP needs the test or the interval page.

jobs.label: Thermostat
jobs.scope: Thermostat and gasket. Housing is a separate yes when it is plastic and weeping
jobs.notes: A stuck-open stat is a temperature test, not a flush. Housing cracks on some fours are a known leak — write housing vs stat-only.
jobs.sayIfHigh: What was the open temperature, and is the housing coming off? Thermostat above {high} in this ZIP needs hours and whether the housing is extra.

jobs.label: Control arm (one)
jobs.scope: One arm, bushings and ball joint as a unit. Alignment is a second line
jobs.notes: Play at the joint or a torn bushing — not “the alignment is off.” After the arm, they owe a print. Two arms are two lines.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Which corner, and did you show me the play? One control arm above {high} in this ZIP needs the brand and an alignment print after, not a second full arm labor.

jobs.label: Strut (corner)
jobs.scope: One strut or strut assembly. Pair is two lines. Alignment after
jobs.notes: A wet strut or a broken spring is the why. Quick-strut vs spring compressor — write which. Do not pay four-corner labor for one leak.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Which corner is wet, and is this a loaded assembly? A strut above {high} in this ZIP needs hours and the alignment as its own menu line.

jobs.label: Shock (one)
jobs.scope: One damper, body or separate spring. Not a strut
jobs.notes: Leak or bounce test. Shocks in pairs are a recommendation, not a law — make them write the second side as its own yes.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Which side leaked? One shock above {high} in this ZIP needs the brand. A pair is two authorizations.

jobs.label: Hub / wheel bearing
jobs.scope: Hub-and-bearing unit, one corner. ABS ring is usually in the unit
jobs.notes: Growl that changes with load is the classic test. A tone-ring code without play is a different diagnosis. Press-in bearings are the high-hours end.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Did the growl change when you loaded that corner? Hub bearing above {high} in this ZIP needs hours and whether it is a bolt-on unit or a press.

jobs.label: EVAP purge / canister
jobs.scope: Purge valve, vent valve, or canister after a smoke or flow test
jobs.notes: P0440-family without a smoke test is a parts dartboard. Gas cap first. Canister is not a menu with the oil change.
jobs.sayIfHigh: What smoke or flow test failed? EVAP above {high} in this ZIP needs the failed part name — cap, purge, vent, or canister — on the RO.

jobs.label: PCV valve / hose
jobs.scope: Valve or hose R&R. Not an induction clean
jobs.notes: A rattle or a stuck valve is a cheap test. Do not let this become a $300 “crankcase service.”
jobs.sayIfHigh: PCV above {high} in this ZIP needs the part — valve or hose — and why it is not a $20 bay job.

jobs.label: Serpentine belt
jobs.scope: Accessory belt. Tensioner is a separate yes when it ticks or leans
jobs.notes: Cracks or a chirp. Tensioner and idler are extra parts — write them. This is not a timing belt.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Is the tensioner coming off? Serpentine above {high} in this ZIP needs the belt brand and whether the pulley is a second line.

jobs.label: Transmission drain-and-fill
jobs.scope: Drain-and-fill, OEM fluid, filter only if the pan comes off. Not a pressurized flush
jobs.notes: Many OEMs specify drain-and-fill, not a machine flush. Ask for the fluid name and the interval page. Flush language stays an upsell in the regex book.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Show me the OEM interval page and the fluid name. Drain-and-fill above {high} in this ZIP needs liters on the RO. A flush is a different authorization.

jobs.label: Transfer case service
jobs.scope: Drain-and-fill on a serviceable unit. Filled-for-life needs a why
jobs.notes: Ask for the OEM interval page. A “flush” on a filled-for-life unit is a no unless they wrote a leak or a grind.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Is this unit serviceable on the schedule? Transfer case above {high} in this ZIP needs the fluid spec. A flush is a different yes.

jobs.label: Wiper blades (pair)
jobs.scope: Two blades. Arms and motor are separate
jobs.notes: A glove-box or parking-lot swap on most cars. Beam vs refill — write the brand. Do not pay diagnostic time for streaky glass.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Wipers above {high} in this ZIP are a parts-counter job. I will buy the pair and fit them in the lot.

jobs.label: Exterior bulb
jobs.scope: One exterior bulb. HID/LED assemblies are a different book
jobs.notes: Halogen is a parts-counter part. If the bumper or the wheel-liner comes off, that is the high-hours end — write why. An LED housing is not this band.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Is this a bulb or a whole housing? A bulb above {high} in this ZIP needs the access story on the RO.

jobs.label: Engine air filter
jobs.scope: Panel filter in the air box. Not the cabin filter
jobs.notes: Show the dirty filter. A $90 “air service” that is a $15 panel is padding. Not the cabin filter.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Show me the old filter. Engine air above {high} in this ZIP is a box-clip job. I will decline a bundled “induction” next to it.

jobs.label: Radiator
jobs.scope: Radiator R&R after a leak or a clog the flush did not invent
jobs.notes: Dye or a wet seam. A flush is not a radiator. Fans, condensers, and crash bars can add time — write them.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Where is it wet? Radiator above {high} in this ZIP needs hours and whether the condenser or the fan is riding along.

jobs.label: Tie rod (one)
jobs.scope: Inner or outer, one side. Alignment after
jobs.notes: Play at the joint. Inner vs outer — write which. Alignment is a menu line after, not free, not a second steering rack.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Inner or outer, and which side? Tie rod above {high} in this ZIP needs the print after. I will not authorize a rack unless you show the play there.

jobs.label: Sway-bar link / bushing
jobs.scope: One link or a bushing set. Bar itself is rare
jobs.notes: Clunk over small bumps. Links are cheap. Do not replace the bar because a bushing squeaks.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Link or bushing? Sway-bar work above {high} in this ZIP needs the part name. I will decline a whole bar without a bend or a crack.

jobs.label: CV axle (one)
jobs.scope: One half-shaft. Boot-only is a different, shorter book when they still offer it
jobs.notes: Click on a turn is the classic. A torn boot without click can be a boot kit if they still do it. Two axles are two lines.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Click on which turn? One CV axle above {high} in this ZIP needs reman vs new and whether a boot-only was offered.

jobs.label: Ignition coil (one)
jobs.scope: One coil. A set is only after a misfire test names more than one
jobs.notes: Swap test or a misfire counter. Replacing a full set because one failed is a sales habit. Plugs are a separate line.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Which cylinder misfired? One coil above {high} in this ZIP needs the cylinder on the RO. A full set is a second conversation.

jobs.label: Oxygen sensor
jobs.scope: One upstream or downstream sensor after a fuel-trim or heater test
jobs.notes: P0420 is not automatically a sensor. Upstream vs downstream — write the bank and the position. Seized threads are the high-hours end.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Which bank and which position? O2 above {high} in this ZIP needs the code and why it is not a converter or an exhaust leak.

jobs.label: Fuel pump
jobs.scope: In-tank or in-line pump after a pressure or current test
jobs.notes: Pressure and rest-leak numbers first. A sender vs a pump module — write which. Dropping the tank is the high-hours story.
jobs.sayIfHigh: What was the fuel pressure? Pump above {high} in this ZIP needs hours and tank-drop vs access panel on the RO.

jobs.label: Valve-cover gasket
jobs.scope: One cover. Tube seals and coils come off and go back
jobs.notes: Oil at the plug wells or down the block. A seeping gasket is not a new cover unless it is cracked. Two banks are two lines on a V.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Which bank is wet? Valve-cover gasket above {high} in this ZIP needs hours. I will not pay a new cover without a crack.

jobs.label: Differential service
jobs.scope: Drain-and-fill, one axle. Limited-slip additive when the tag says so
jobs.notes: Interval or a leak. Filled-for-life needs a why. A “flush” is usually a drain-and-fill with a fancier name.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Front or rear, and is it on the schedule? Diff service above {high} in this ZIP needs the spec. A flush is a different yes.

jobs.label: Tire rotation
jobs.scope: Rotate and set door-sticker PSI. Balance is a second menu when they felt a shake
jobs.notes: Menu price. Date codes and PSI belong on the ticket. A $90 “tire service” that is a rotation is padding.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Rotation above {high} in this ZIP is a menu miss. Write PSI and the date codes or I will take it to a tire shop.

jobs.label: Parking-brake service
jobs.scope: Shoes or EPB service, one axle. Not a pad job
jobs.notes: EPB needs a scan-tool retract — that is time, not a mystery fee. Shoes inside a drum-in-hat are a different access story.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Cable, shoes, or EPB module? Parking brake above {high} in this ZIP needs the part and whether a retract procedure was used.

jobs.label: Window regulator
jobs.scope: One door, regulator and often the motor as a unit
jobs.notes: Motor vs regulator — write which. Clips and vapor barrier are not a $200 “programming.” Two doors are two lines.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Motor, regulator, or both? Window work above {high} in this ZIP needs the door and the part name on the RO.

jobs.label: MAF sensor
jobs.scope: Mass-air or inlet-air sensor after a pintest, not a spray-can ritual
jobs.notes: A cleaner spray is not a $240 sensor. Fuel trims and a known-good compare come first.
jobs.sayIfHigh: What trim or voltage failed? MAF above {high} in this ZIP needs the test. I will decline a sensor that is only “dirty.”

jobs.label: Brake hose (one)
jobs.scope: One flexible hose. Bleed after. Not a pad job
jobs.notes: Wet fitting or a swollen hose. Hard lines are a different book. Bleed is in the hours, not a second flush menu.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Which corner is wet? One brake hose above {high} in this ZIP needs the side. A four-hose package is four yeses.

jobs.label: Fuel filter
jobs.scope: In-line or under-car filter. In-tank socks ride with the pump
jobs.notes: Lifetime in-tank filters are not a menu. An under-car canister on an older truck is this band. Depressurize first.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Is this an in-line filter or a tank sock? Fuel filter above {high} in this ZIP needs the location on the RO.

jobs.label: Blower motor
jobs.scope: Cabin blower R&R after a voltage-drop or resistor test. Not a cabin-filter upsell
jobs.notes: Resistor vs motor vs control module — write which failed. A dead fan is not a $90 pollen filter. Typical hours — not Motor.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Motor, resistor, or module? Blower work above {high} in this ZIP needs the test and the part name on the RO.

jobs.label: Crankshaft position sensor
jobs.scope: CKP after a sync or no-start test. Not a crankshaft
jobs.notes: No-start or a correlation code first. Some engines hide it behind the starter or the harmonic — that is the high-hours end, written. Typical hours — not Motor.
jobs.sayIfHigh: What code or sync failed? CKP above {high} in this ZIP needs the location and whether the starter or pulley comes off.

jobs.label: Camshaft position sensor
jobs.scope: One CMP after a correlation or cam-signal test. VVT solenoids stay a second line
jobs.notes: Bank and intake vs exhaust. A VVT solenoid is not this sensor. Typical hours — not Motor.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Which bank, and was it a correlation or a circuit code? Cam sensor above {high} in this ZIP needs the side on the RO.

jobs.label: TPMS sensor (one)
jobs.scope: One wheel sensor plus a relearn. Not a four-corner package by default
jobs.notes: One dead ID is one sensor. A four-pack on a single light needs four IDs written. Relearn is in the hours. Typical hours — not Motor.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Which corner ID failed? One TPMS above {high} in this ZIP is a menu miss. Four sensors are four yeses.

jobs.label: Belt tensioner / idler
jobs.scope: Automatic tensioner or one idler. Belt can ride along if they write it
jobs.notes: Wobble or a chirp that follows the pulley, not a bottled dressing. A water-pump job is a different book. Typical hours — not Motor.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Tensioner, idler, or the belt? Above {high} in this ZIP needs the pulley name. The pump stays off unless they show play.

jobs.label: Radiator hose (one)
jobs.scope: One upper or lower radiator hose. Coolant top-off in the hours. Not a flush menu
jobs.notes: Soft, swollen, or leaking at the clamp. A machine flush is a second yes. Typical hours — not Motor.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Upper or lower, and was it wet? One hose above {high} in this ZIP needs the side. A flush is not this line.

jobs.label: Wheel-speed sensor
jobs.scope: One ABS / wheel-speed sensor after a scan. Hub assemblies stay a second book
jobs.notes: Tone ring vs sensor vs a rusted hub harness. Write the corner and the code. Typical hours — not Motor.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Which corner and which code? Wheel-speed above {high} in this ZIP needs the side. A hub is a second authorization.

jobs.label: Door lock actuator
jobs.scope: One door actuator. Latch vs actuator — write which. Programming is not a mystery fee
jobs.notes: One door. Two doors are two lines. Clips and the vapor barrier are in the hours. Typical hours — not Motor.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Which door, actuator or latch? Lock work above {high} in this ZIP needs the side on the RO.

jobs.label: Knock sensor
jobs.scope: One knock sensor after a pintest. Intake-off jobs are the high-hours end, written
jobs.notes: A P0325-family code and a known-good compare. Some V6s bury it under the intake — that time must be on the RO. Typical hours — not Motor.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Does the intake come off? Knock sensor above {high} in this ZIP needs the hours and the bank.

jobs.label: Washer pump
jobs.scope: One reservoir pump. Front vs rear. Not a wiper-blade menu
jobs.notes: Click at the pump vs a cracked reservoir. Fluid on the ground is a bottle, not a $200 “washer service.” Typical hours — not Motor.
jobs.sayIfHigh: Pump or bottle? Washer pump above {high} in this ZIP needs which reservoir. Blades stay a separate yes.
